checklist: Threat model T4 (S7): sidecars another app writes between the open and Save. The shoot is app-xmp-lightroom's (DSC08186.xmp, DSC08187.XMP with 2★, DSC08190 without one). After the read, 'Lightroom' saves different develop settings into DSC08186.xmp (the real sidecar of DSC08187: Exposure -0.19 instead of +0.30), makes a sidecar for DSC08190 (the real one of DSC08186) and DSC08187.XMP is deleted. ⌘↩ then merges onto what is on disk NOW: the newer settings survive byte for byte with only the rating changed, the sidecar made since the open is merged (not replaced by a fresh one), the deleted one comes back fresh (not from the text read at open), each replaced file is kept as .lumina-bak exactly as the other app left it, and the RAWs never change. The text from the open is never written.
